LOG CHECK (read-only), data as of 2026-10-28 16:40Z. Sources: viewer-authproxy nginx access logs (2 pods, ~50h back, so 10-27 and 10-28 covered), beads-viewer pod log (6h only; pod is 12h old so 10-27 viewer logs are gone), gardenio-forwardauth log. No ingress read perm for the infra SA. No secrets/emails below.

SERVERS WERE NOT RESTARTING
- Deploy is gardenio-beads-viewer (not beads-viewer). Pod gardenio-beads-viewer-6687fdc8fd-cl6kt: Restart Count 0, started 10-28 04:37Z, no OOM, limit 1Gi. Nothing viewer-side explains a reload.
- viewer-authproxy x2: one pod restarted once on 10-26 (Exit 255, reason Unknown), nothing since. forwardauth: only 401s on dashboard.clonk.tv (unrelated).
- Viewer log is dominated by noise: 696x "garden farm: closed-step read hit the row cap" (cap 2000, every ~30s), 72x "arms gauge: counting epics failed ... read requires per-request user bearer" (every 5 min), a burst of "walking produced MRs for recent-runs strip ... context canceled" at 15:48:58 (client aborted /agents?density=compact), and one cluster of upstream/read failures at 10:45:51 (beads + vmsingle unreachable, desktop UA got 3x 502 at 10:46:01). No panic/reset/timeout lines near any mobile reload.

ERRORS ON /garden* (6h): 2112x200, 164x204, 24x304, 9x499, 4x502. 502s: 3 at 10:46:01 (desktop Firefox, matches the 10:45:51 upstream blip) and 1 at 15:49:46 GET /garden/glass/<id>/prompt (iPhone Safari). No 4xx. 499s (client aborted) are all iPhone Safari/FxiOS, nearly all on GET /garden/c/unread. 10-27 had many more 499s (mobile, same endpoints) plus desktop 404s on POST /garden/c/gardenio/general/read, POST /garden/farm/events/view, GET /garden/splash.

PAGE LOADS (GET /garden exact path, document loads)
- 10-28: 19 total, 18 mobile (iPhone Safari 26.6 and Firefox-iOS "FxiOS") + 1 desktop. 10-27: 61 mobile loads. Not a Safari-only or Android thing: iPhone only.
- 83 of 91 mobile loads over both days have Referer "-" (not link navigations from another page; reload / address bar / home-screen launch / location.href with no referrer). Only 8 had a referer (/agents, /plans/<id>, /<bead>).
- URL at load, mobile: 10-27: 38 plain /garden, 4 ?at=<project>, 19 ?at=<project>/<plan>; 10-28: 9 plain, 9 ?at=<project>, 12 ?at=<project>/<plan>. So loads carrying ?at=project/plan are common (~1/3), but so are project-level ones; the doc request only shows the destination URL so server logs cannot tell reload from navigate.
- 16 of 88 loads came <=10s after a previous mobile load (rapid double/triple loads = reload loop-ish).

TODAY TIMELINE (mobile, UTC; "view" = URL seen on POST /garden/farm/events/view referer)
- 15:45:41 view at=yard/agent -> 15:45:45 LOAD at=gardenio -> 15:46:36 view at=gardenio/gd-MEGB3dEaHu -> 15:47:46 view at=gardenio/gd-eRFLdnAEeB -> 15:47:47 LOAD at=gardenio/gd-agyF0escIN (page URL changed to a *different* plan than last SPA view, one second later).
- 15:48:30 LOAD /garden (plain) + GET / 302 -> 15:48:32 LOAD at=gardenio/gd-agyF0escIN (499 on /garden/c/unread same second) -> 15:48:38 LOAD same URL again, 304. Three loads in 8s.
- 16:18:09-16:18:37: ~12 distinct ?at=gardenio/<plan>[%2Fother] URL changes in 28s (rapid plan hopping) -> 16:18:38 LOAD at=gardenio/gd-YZATAIOhfW (499s on unread at :42, :44) -> 16:18:45 LOAD at=gardenio/gd-0t6m7X5KLC (a different plan than the last view URL) -> 499 unread :50.
- 16:28:18 view at=yard/agent&costs=fleet -> 16:28:22 499 unread -> 16:28:29 LOAD at=gardenio (499, client aborted) -> 16:28:30 LOAD at=gardenio (200). Again two loads 1s apart.
- 16:31:39 LOAD plain /garden, 499 unread. 16:35:54 LOAD ?plan=gd-jMl4oF2cJO (from /plans/..., real link click) -> 16:36:01-:09 three view URLs at=gardenio/<plan> -> 16:36:11 LOAD at=gardenio/gd-pTmaK6Uuem (differs from last view URL gd-5f5bJPKLhC) -> 16:36:54 LOAD ?bead=gd-9EMkNdimuF.
- Pattern: a full document load lands between SPA URL changes, often to a plan URL that differs from the last one the SPA reported, preceded by aborted /garden/c/unread fetches (page unload). That fits a client-side navigation/reload triggered during plan/zoom transitions, not a server fault. Heartbeat/event streams (/garden/events, /garden/farm/events) returned 200 throughout; no stream 4xx/5xx near the reloads.

CAVEATS: authproxy logs don't record Cache-Control/If-None-Match except via 304s, don't distinguish reload from location.href, and iOS PWA/BFCache restores (splash.js has a pageshow persisted -> location.reload at gardenhub/web/splash.js:597) also look like a fresh load with Referer "-". Candidates to check client-side: any code path that sets location.href/reload on zoom-out from at=project/plan to at=project (stip.js/tour.js/chat.js use location.href; garden.js cursorTo/cursorInto should use history, worth a trace), and iOS killing the tab under memory pressure (would show as Referer "-" loads right after a long idle/background; the 15:48:30 plain /garden + GET / 302 looks like a home-screen/PWA launch).
No config or state changed by this check.
